name: Mumble Server (Murmur)
description: Open-source low-latency voice chat server. Static Murmur binary downloaded from the official Mumble GitHub releases.

variables.label: Murmur version
variables.description: GitHub release tag used in the download URL (1.3.4 is the last release with a static server binary). Re-run install after changing it.

variables.label: Welcome message
variables.default: Welcome to a Between-powered Mumble server.

notes: The static binary is 32-bit (runs fine on x86_64 kernels with 32-bit ELF support and needs no extra libraries). Set the SuperUser password once while the server is stopped: ./murmur.x86 -ini murmur.ini -supw <password>. All state lives in murmur.sqlite. Newer Mumble servers (1.4/1.5) ship as distro packages or Docker images rather than static tarballs.
